sources.title: GEN 1.3 — Entry, Transit and Departure of Passengers and Crew
sources.publisher: Syrian General Authority of Civil Aviation
sources.officialityEvidence: The live official Syrian eAIP is published by the Syrian General Authority of Civil Aviation and identifies the current GEN 1.3 amendment as effective 27 March 2026. It supplies an advance-visa default but no nationality annex or exemption schedule.
sources.supportingExcerpt: Entry visa obtained in advance from a Syrian diplomatic mission, unless exempt.

sources.title: Foreign Ministry: no changes to procedures for arrivals to Syria
sources.publisher: Syrian Arab News Agency (SANA), Ministry of Information
sources.officialityEvidence: The official state news agency reports the Foreign Ministry confirmation that Decision 128 of 1 July 2025 remains in force. The live notice does not publish a nationality/passport annex or an issuance schedule.
sources.supportingExcerpt: الإجراءات المعتمدة في دخول سوريا لا تزال سارية المفعول وفق القرار رقم 128
